'''Crops''' are [[plants]] that may be grown at [[farm]] plots. There are two types of crops: above ground and subterranean. The [[seed]]s of subterranean crops may be brought from the starting screen or purchased from the [[dwarf]] [[trade]]rs. Above ground crops may be gathered by dwarves with the [[plant gathering]] labor enabled.
